note: T7-P1 (/search partial refusal per (record, pair), the owner's decision of 2026-11-14; SPEC-multigraph-envelope.md section 3). With the request field partial_refusal (a boolean, false when absent, read as with_signature; it joins the result cache's key), a unit, one FASTA record on one pair, whose values (its rows and their per-position values) or whose own JSON object would pass --search-max-answer-memory-mb is answered alone, as a refused cut entry: the record's object keeps its seq_description (and, with align, the first pair's alignment), the unit's rows are missing, and its entry in cuts (one a pair searched, in pair order, as every entry) states the pair's tags, returned 0, complete false, nth_score null, tied and tied_returned 0 (nth_median null and tied_same_median 0 where the cut has abundances) and refused: {account, code: "search_answer_too_large", max_memory_mb}, plus priced_mb with account "answer". An answered entry has no refused member. Every other unit is answered byte for byte as without a budget, and the status is 200; the request's answer account passing still refuses the whole request, 400 "answer" (sample 75). A refused entry never means that nothing matched: the caller did not get this unit's rows, and may retry the record alone on the pair, with fewer top_labels, a larger discovery_fraction or no per-position values; the same request on the same server and index is refused in the same units. A client counts the refused entries in cuts; GET /capabilities states search.unit_refused (sample 12), and an engine before it ignores the field. Here query_coords on bact_other (2,000 columns sharing one 100 bp stretch) and inv_insecta (the first 10 of them), the bound 1 MiB: q1, the stretch, is refused on bact_other ("values": its 2,000 rows of coordinates) and answered on inv_insecta (10 rows); q2 (w0000's first flank and the stretch's first 30 bp: w0000 alone) is answered on both. Without the field the same request is refused whole, 400 "values" (as sample 60). A real run, the bound 1 MiB so that the sample stays short; at the default bound the same request answered every unit (462,073 bytes of text).
